The importance of possessing these qualities is present in many aspects of the Islamic tradition and culture, from the struggle of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in establishing Islam in Mecca, to the everyday strength and fortitude required to lead a faithful life. Therefore, the name serves not only as a reminder to the bearer of their inherent abilities, but also serves to honor and pay homage to the history and heritage of their community.

Islam teaches that trials and tribulations are an inevitable part of life, and it is through these tests that one's faith and character are shaped. The name serves as a reminder to never give in to adversity, but instead to draw upon one's inner resources and draw closer to Allah (swt) during times of hardship.
